text: {"lessons":["A realized gain can feel rewarding, but it is not proof that selling was the best choice; decide based on the holding’s role and my overall plan.","Repeatedly selling winners did not stop my account value from declining, so I should evaluate total portfolio performance rather than celebrate gains in isolation.","With prices moving randomly and frequent checking tempting me to react, I should follow a steady plan instead of trading on short-term changes or emotions."]}
